site.description: Claude writes, Codex reviews. Run coding agents in parallel on your own machine.
site.intro: Run Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents in parallel, each in its own git worktree. When one finishes, another model reviews the work, and you decide what ships.
site.downloadNote: Apple silicon and Intel · free and open source (MIT)
site.parallelBody: Each task runs in its own worktree with the real agent CLI, so agents never get in each other's way.
site.reviewBody: When the work is done, another model reviews it read-only. Send the findings back with one click.
site.supportBody: Questions, bug reports and feature requests are handled on GitHub. Search the existing issues first; if nothing matches, open a new one and we'll get back to you.
site.legalLanguage: This document is available in English and Simplified Chinese.
site.agentsTitle: Works with the agents you already use
site.agentsMore: Plus any other CLI agent, through a plugin
site.featuresTitle: Everything a team of agents needs
site.featuresIntro: Duolo keeps every agent in its own lane, shows you what needs attention, and gets a second opinion before you merge.
site.chatBody: Use the agent's own terminal, or switch to a chat view with tool calls and approval buttons. It's the same session either way.
site.handoffBody: Pass a task to another agent to review it, take over, or continue on a new branch. It gets the request and the recent conversation.
site.gridBody: Watch up to six tasks at once. Tasks waiting for you come first, so nothing sits idle.
site.voiceBody: Hold Fn and speak. File and function names from the task come out right, even when you mix languages.
site.autoBody: Run tasks on a schedule, or tell the agent “every weekday at 9” and it sets one up.
site.accountsBody: Sign in to several accounts. When one runs out, Duolo switches to the next and continues the conversation.
site.cliBody: Create, list and hand off tasks from your shell, or run everything over SSH with duolo tui.
site.step1Body: Open a folder, clone from GitHub, or pick a repository Duolo found on your computer.
site.step2Body: Type or say what you want. Duolo creates a branch and a worktree and starts the agent.
site.step3Body: A second model reviews the changes read-only. Send the findings back, then merge the branch.
site.mobileTitle: Coming soon: Duolo on your phone
site.mobileBody: Check on your agents, answer their questions and start new tasks from iPhone or Android, end-to-end encrypted between your phone and your computer.
site.a1: A desktop app that runs coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex in parallel, each in its own git worktree, with a second model reviewing the work.
site.a2: Yes. Duolo is free and open source under the MIT License. The agents use your own subscriptions or API keys.
site.a3: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, pi and Grok out of the box. You can add others as a plugin with a short agent.toml file.
site.q4: Does my code leave my computer?
site.a4: Duolo doesn't upload your code. Agents talk to their own providers with your accounts, just as they do in a terminal. Voice input sends the audio and a few hints from the task to our server for recognition.
site.q5: Does it run on Windows and Linux?
site.a5: Duolo builds for Windows and Linux and is tested there in CI, but for now you build it from source. The signed installer is for Mac.
site.a6: No. The desktop app works without signing up.
site.ctaBody: Free and open source. Bring your own agents.
site.footerTagline: Run a team of coding agents on your own machine.
